lines.1: The fierce battles of the Sports and Martial Arts Festival continued.
lines.2: Seriously, who holds a sports festival at this time of year?
lines.3: It was so hot I could barely stand it.
lines.7: 「We won the boys' class pole-toppling match, but Subaru hurt his fist.」
lines.8: 「There were too many people for me to see. How did he hurt it?」
lines.13: 「Fukahire, watch out! Don't just stand there!」
lines.16: 「No. My injury is my own responsibility.」
lines.17: 「--This is bad. The East Army is three hundred billion points ahead. Unless someone from the West Army wins the next Dragon Cup, we'll be locked into second place.」
lines.18: The Dragon Cup was the boys' combat tournament Subaru had entered.
lines.19: It was the festival's showcase event and worth a great many points.
lines.20: 「Sorry I let you down when it mattered.」
lines.21: 「No, you've already won plenty of events and contributed more than enough. Don't worry about it.」
lines.22: It would be cruel to blame Subaru after everything he had done for us.
lines.23: But what could we do about the next combat event?
lines.24: Nobody in the West Army besides Subaru looked especially strong.
lines.25: We apparently had many skilled archers and swordsmen, but they were poorly suited to unarmed combat, and weapons were forbidden.
lines.26: Without a truly exceptional brawler, we could not beat the East Army's many martial-arts club members.
lines.27: 「...Losing to Class 2-A's East Army like this would be humiliating. More importantly, my livelihood...」
lines.28: 「Hey, hey. Why the long faces, everybody?」
lines.29: 「The moment you give up, the match is over! Let's all do our best! Don't lose heart!」
lines.30: 「...He's the reason Subaru got hurt and we're worried. That really annoys me.」
lines.31: 「Now, now. Have you forgotten that I entered too?」
lines.32: 「No complaints if I take Subaru's place, right?」
lines.34: 「Don't look so uncertain. I have brains.」
lines.35: 「I'll use this intellect with supreme cunning and aim for first place. Most of my wins will probably be by default.」
lines.36: 「Then I'll become the class hero and beauties like the Princess and Yoppi will fawn over me.」
lines.39: 「And if anyone discovers you cheated, the West Army will be disqualified.」
lines.43: 「A book I treasure describes a forbidden occult art called 'Channel 4 3/4.'」
lines.45: 「It gathers radio waves drifting through the atmosphere and fashions the sacrifice into another personality.」
lines.48: 「Yes. But I cannot guarantee Fukahire's physical safety. Is that acceptable?」
lines.54: 「An empty head has more room for radio waves.」
lines.58: 「I'll do it. I'll win for you, Princess.」
lines.60: 「Then let us begin the ritual at once.」
lines.61: 「Everyone, please help construct the magic circle.」
lines.63: 「It is probably a matter of atmosphere.」
lines.64: 「All right, the book says to write DEATH there.」
lines.66: 「What now? Class 2-C is doing something weird again.」
lines.70: 「If you need a sacrifice, should I bring something?」
lines.71: 「According to this book, the possessed person is the sacrifice, so there is no problem.」
lines.74: 「It says here, 'Note: the sacrifice will experience extreme pain during summoning--specifically, like being dragged behind a motorcycle and then hit with a wrestler's finishing move.'」
lines.77: Ms. Inori produced a sheet of paper.
lines.83: 「Let us begin. Tsushima, please hold this paper.」
lines.85: What was this paper? I decided to read it.
lines.86: ...The school bears no responsibility whatsoever for anything that occurs from this point forward.
lines.88: 「Come, come! Take this one's entrails as your offering and come forth from the Eighth World!」
lines.89: 「Isn't that incantation strange? Why is it so bloody?」
lines.90: 「...Thus do we offer up this sacrifice's soul and life.」
lines.91: 「Hey, don't offer those without permission! The Princess will be sad!」
lines.94: Purple static electricity flashed above Fukahire's head.
lines.99: 「Who in the world is going to possess him?!」
lines.100: 「A developed high-pressure system over Kanto will bring continued clear skies from tomorrow, though the rainy season will return at the start of next week...」
lines.102: 「An invisible antenna has risen from his body. Now we need only wait for something to descend.」
lines.105: 「Now, let us have you introduce your next friend.」
lines.106: 「You went too far up the dial.」
lines.123: Our class was not exactly normal.
